messages:

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Marketplace listing + co-sell — quick checklist and timeline

Connor / Ben / Olga — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We left with two priorities: (1) confirm what evidence and SKUs AWS/GCP require for an initial listing, and (2) understand what co-sell tag / commitment we need to get to co-sell enablement.

High level asks from our side:
- A short checklist of required security/compliance artifacts (SOC2, data handling, telemetry).
- How entitlements / SKUs should be structured for per-seat vs. consumption models.
- Any minimum pricing or usage commitments needed for co-sell uplift.
- Recommended first-cloud strategy if we want to launch both AWS and GCP but prioritize one.

We also have a procurement timeline from the Acme legal team — they want to get initial listing live within 6 weeks if possible. Can you outline the gaps and a mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Ash Patel
Head of Partnerships | Acme Analytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell — quick checklist and timeline

Team — summary of Ash's ask and proposed approach below. Pulling together the items we regularly surface for ISV marketplace listings + co-sell.

Key evidence buckets (we should attach: acme_co-sell_evidence_checklist.pdf):
- Security/compliance: SOC2 Type II report, Data Processing Addendum, logging/audit retention window.
- Technical: Integration guides for SSO/OAuth, container image or AMI prescription, API specs and sample traffic.
- Billing/metering: Pricing matrix showing SKU mapping and metering endpoints for usage-based models.
- GTM: Sales collateral, case studies, and co-sell playbook draft.

Marketplace sequencing recommendation: Launch on AWS first as the primary co-sell target (larger co-sell program, faster enablement) and run a parallel GCP readiness track. For AWS we'll need to:
1) Finalize SKU mapping + pricing commitments (Ben lead).
2) Prepare evidence bundle for AWS listing (Olga lead).
3) Confirm co-sell tagging & sales enablement steps with AWS partner team (Vivek to coordinate).

Risks / gaps I see now:
- Acme doesn't have a formal metering endpoint documented that matches marketplace ingestion patterns.
- Pricing matrix has open items around minimum committed spend and reseller margins.
- SOC2 report is in progress; expected delivery 3 weeks out.

Next steps I propose:
- Share the attached evidence checklist + pricing template with Acme (attached).
- Quick sync (30 min) Tue 10/20 to build Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and confirm owners.
- Introduce Vivek to the AWS partner rep to confirm co-sell tag path.

I attached: acme_co-sell_evidence_checklist.pdf, acme_pricing_matrix.xlsx (templates).

Connor O'Brien
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell — quick checklist and timeline

Connor — added a few concrete asks based on the SKU/entitlement side that Acme should prepare. Copying Ash so they can action.

Ben's SKU / metering checklist:
- SKU taxonomy: define product SKUs for (a) hosted seats, (b) API consumption (tokens/requests), and (c) enterprise bundle (support + SLA). Marketplace prefers clear 1:1 SKU -> billing event mapping.
- Metering API: provide swagger for metering endpoint and example payloads; confirm event latency and duplicate suppression behaviour.
- Free tier / trial SKUs: identify any trial entitlements and how trial conversions will be tracked.
- Minimum commitment: AWS co-sell often asks for an enablement commitment (discount or $ commitment) — we need Acme's preferred threshold to negotiate.

Notes on legal/compliance evidence: if SOC2 isn't available in the 6-week window, we can submit a SOC2-in-progress letter plus compensating controls for the initial listing. Olga can scope what that requires.

Drive folder with suggested templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAcmeMarketplaceEvidence
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/ACM-0042

I'll draft the pricing table if Ash shares usage profile for the first 3 months (estimated MAUs and API calls).

Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell — quick checklist and timeline (MAP + kickoff)

Ash / team — thanks for the quick turn. Based on the gap analysis above, here is a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with owners and target dates to hit a listing + co-sell ready state. I left a few optional paths where we can accelerate.

MAP (targets assume AWS-first launch)
1) Evidence bundle upload (Olga / Acme Legal) — evidence checklist, SOC2-in-progress letter if SOC2 not yet ready. Target: 2026-11-05
2) SKU & pricing finalization (Ben / Acme Product) — complete pricing matrix and map SKUs to metering events. Target: 2026-10-27
3) Metering API docs + sandbox (Acme Eng / Redwood infra point) — provide Swagger and sandbox endpoint. Target: 2026-10-29
4) Co-sell enablement intro (Vivek -> AWS rep) — confirm the co-sell tagging flow and any partner incentives. Target: 2026-10-22
5) Sales enablement pack (Connor / Ben) — one-pager, demo script, buyer objection FAQ for marketplace sellers. Target: 2026-10-31

Optional acceleration: If Acme can front the SOC2 interim letter and the metering sandbox by 10/22, we can submit the listing request to AWS the following week and request expedited review.

Kickoff call: I scheduled a 30-minute MAP kickoff Tuesday 10/20 at 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent to Ash + core team. Please review the attachments and HubSpot deal before the call.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EX-ACME-2026-10 (NDA / partner agreement draft)
